payload.abstract: The ECGRDVQ database contains multi-channel ECG recordings of 22 healthy subjects partaking in a randomized, double‐blind, 5‐period crossover clinical trial aimed at comparing the effects of four known QT prolonging drugs versus placebo on electrophysiological and other clinical parameters.

payload.title: ECG Effects of Ranolazine, Dofetilide, Verapamil, and Quinidine
